helpers.logic: Set data's 'helper' to {stateIdMap: {STATE_INIT: 10, STATE_INT_HELLO: 11, STATE_NORMAL: 12, STATE_INT_CHANGE_PARAM: 22}, resetType: {NONE: 0, RESET: 1, RESET_CAST_ABILITY: 2}, resetByResetType: given (arg1, arg2) { Let executer be the acting enemy of arg1. Depending on arg2 { Case this state's 'resetType''s 'NONE' { Break. } Case this state's 'resetType''s 'RESET' { Reset executer. Break. } Case this state's 'resetType''s 'RESET_CAST_ABILITY' { Executer cancels its cast. Break. } Default { Fail with new Error with (call sprintf with ("invalid resetType [%d]", arg2)). } } }, countupSnippet: given () { Return game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister. }, getNextBattlePhaseIndex: given (arg) { Repeat, starting with let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent' also let battlePhaseConfList be globalRegister's 'conf''s 'battlePhaseConfList' also let executer be the acting enemy of arg also let hpRate be the HP fraction of executer also let v9 be the length of battlePhaseConfList minus 1, while v9 is more than 0, stepping v9 before decreasing { If hpRate is at most battlePhaseConfList at v9's 'hpRate', then return v9. } Return 0. }, shouldChangeBattlePhase: given (arg) { Return (the register of arg's 'parent')'s 'currentBattlePhaseIdx' is less than this state → get-next-battle-phase-index with (arg). }, getInterruptAbilityForChangeParam: given (arg1, arg2) { Let globalRegister be the register of arg1's 'parent'. Let battlePhaseConfList be globalRegister's 'conf''s 'battlePhaseConfList'. Let v9 be battlePhaseConfList at arg2. Let interruptAbilitys be v9's 'interruptAbilitys'. Let list2 be []. For each x in interruptAbilitys, append x to list2. Return list2. }, getResetTypeForChangeParam: given (arg1, arg2) { If any x in arg2 where not not x's 'abilityTag', then return this state's 'resetType''s 'RESET'. Otherwise, return this state's 'resetType''s 'RESET_CAST_ABILITY'. }, countup: given (arg) { This state → countup-snippet → update with (arg, "currentBattlePhaseTurn"). }, registerAbility: given (arg) { (the acting enemy of arg) → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}). }}.

Set data's 'makeJson' to given (arg) { Let v9 be _ → extend with ({}, this state's 'helper', arg's 'helper'). Let battlePhaseConfList be arg's 'battlePhaseConfList'. Let abilityDeformMapTag be arg's 'abilityDeformMapTag'. Let helloMessageId be arg's 'helloMessageId'. Let v10 be v9 → countup-snippet. Return {startStateId: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INIT', globalRegister: {conf: arg, currentBattlePhaseIdx: 0, currentBattlePhaseTurn: v10's 'INIT_TURN'}, states: [{id: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INIT', class: "InitState", memberValues: {nextStateId: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INT_HELLO', paramId: battlePhaseConfList at 0's 'paramId', abilityDeformMapTag: abilityDeformMapTag}}, {id: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INT_HELLO', class: "InterruptAbility", memberValues: {nextStateId: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_NORMAL', abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageId: helloMessageId}]]}}}, {id: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_NORMAL', update: given () { Let self be the acting enemy. V9 → countup with (this state). If not (call game:AbilityMgr.getInstance) → exists-registered-interrupt-ability with ({upperEqualBoss: true}) and self can act, then { If v9 → should-change-battle-phase with (this state), then choose state v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INT_CHANGE_PARAM' next and stop. Otherwise { If self is ready to act, then v9 uses this state. Stop. } } }, transitions: [{class: "NextStateIdTransition"}], conditionFlags: [v10 → get-condition-flag-hash]}, {id: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_INT_CHANGE_PARAM', class: "InterruptMultipleAbility", inState: [given (arg2) { Let globalRegister be the script register. Let nextBattlePhaseIndex be v9 → get-next-battle-phase-index with (this state). Let v11 be battlePhaseConfList at nextBattlePhaseIndex. Let interruptAbilityForChangeParam be v9 → get-interrupt-ability-for-change-param with (this state, nextBattlePhaseIndex). Let v12 be 0. Let data3 be {}. For each x in interruptAbilityForChangeParam, set data3 at (increased v12) to x. If v12 is 0, then set data3 at (increased v12) to {abilityId: the built-in move DO_NOTHING}. Set the state settings's 'paramId' to v11's 'paramId'. Set the state settings's 'abilityCount' to v12. Set the state settings's 'abilitySettingMap' to data3. Set globalRegister's 'currentBattlePhaseIdx' to nextBattlePhaseIndex. V10 → reset with (this state, "currentBattlePhaseTurn"). Set this state's '_resetType' to v9 → get-reset-type-for-change-param with (this state, interruptAbilityForChangeParam). Call arg2. }, "CHANGE_PARAM"], outState: [given (arg2) { V9 → reset-by-reset-type with (this state, this state's '_resetType'). Call arg2. }], memberValues: {paramId: nothing, nextStateId: v9's 'stateIdMap''s 'STATE_NORMAL', abilityCount: nothing, abilitySettingMap: nothing}}]}. }.
